description:
【Aviation-Grade Carbon Steel Frame】: The aviation-grade high-carbon steel bicycle frame is both sturdy and durable. With a front suspension fork and a rear coil spring shock absorber, it can effectively smooth out bumps along the way.

【Unmatched Drivetrain】: The 7-speed twist shift gearbox enables effortless gear changes, helping you find the perfect riding rhythm and enjoy the journey ahead.

【Redefined Safety】: V-brakes, anti-slip tires, and a lock-out suspension fork ensure instant responsiveness, allowing you to navigate any terrain with confidence.

【Tailored Comfort】: The adjustable handlebars and ergonomic seat cushion allow you to customize your riding position, making the bike suitable for riders ranging from 5.3 feet to 6.2 feet in height.

【Easy Assembly】: With installation tools and instructions included, you can assemble the bike in under 20 minutes. Please watch the installation video on our page before assembly.
